Pop bubbles, master challenging levels and take on other players in duels.

In COCOBOUM!, you pop bubbles and work through levels that become increasingly challenging. Watch for obstacles, choose your moment carefully and adjust your strategy as each level introduces a new challenge.

Crossword puzzle game on iPhone | Royaume des Mots Croisés
Solve crosswords, earn coins and grow a medieval village in Royaume des Mots Croisés, now available on iPhone.
Solve crossword puzzles and build your own kingdom.
Crossword puzzles meet a growing medieval kingdom

Royaume des Mots Croisés combines word puzzles with the pleasure of developing a medieval village. Solving grids is part of a larger adventure: each successful challenge helps you move towards building a kingdom, one small step at a time.

The planned gameplay revolves around solving crossword grids, earning ducats and using those rewards to grow your village. It brings together vocabulary puzzles and a kingdom-building theme, giving players a reason to return to the next grid.
The project currently plans to keep your progress on your phone without requiring an account.

Yoga, nutrition and well-being app | Mieux Chaque Jour
Mieux Chaque Jour: a well-being app with nutrition and yoga to help you make progress every day. Available on iPhone.
Yoga, nutrition and small steps towards well-being.
Yoga, nutrition and habits: Mieux Chaque Jour on iPhone

Mieux Chaque Jour is a well-being app available on iPhone, designed to bring several everyday activities together in one place: yoga exercises, guidance on food and nutrition, and simple habits, with a gradual approach rather than a single goal to reach.

Three themes: moving with step-by-step guided exercises, better understanding your food choices with a guide to 1,500 foods and 1,000 recipes, and keeping track of small well-being habits throughout the day, at your own pace.

It may appeal to people who want to take time for themselves, discover yoga or build a personal routine. Well-being information is not a substitute for medical advice or support suited to a specific health situation.
Mieux Chaque Jour is available now on the App Store for iPhone: tap the App Store button at the top of this page to download it. The Android version is planned for November 15, 2026.
Free puzzle game without ads | Les Tableaux Ensorcelés
Play Les Tableaux Ensorcelés for free on Android / iPhone and iPad, with no ads. Complete 50 magical puzzles and restore an enchanted castle.
Restore 50 enchanted paintings in a magical castle.
Restore an enchanted castle, one puzzle at a time

Les Tableaux Ensorcelés is a free puzzle game available for Android / iPhone and iPad. Step into a fantasy castle filled with paintings waiting to be restored. The story follows Maître Léonard as the castle faces the mischief of Barbouille and Malgrimoire.
What kinds of puzzles are there?

The game features 50 enchanted paintings with challenges ranging from 9 to 100 pieces. It offers two puzzle styles: sliding puzzles and traditional jigsaw-style puzzles, allowing players to approach the artwork in different ways.
What else is there to discover?

Alongside the paintings, the game includes a five-room gallery to restore and decorate, a daily puzzle, weekly challenges, rewards and a five-minute Royal Duel. Features may evolve with future updates.
Les Tableaux Ensorcelés is free and ad-free on iPhone and iPad. Download it now using the App Store button above.

Medieval arrow puzzle game | Sauve qui Flèche !
Sauve qui Flèche! (Arrow Escape): get every arrow off the board in the right order through medieval levels full of keys, doors and teleporters. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
Free the arrows one by one without blocking them.
An arrow puzzle in a medieval castle

In Sauve qui Flèche!, each level is a board full of arrows. Tap an arrow to send it flying in its direction: if the path is clear, it escapes. The challenge is to find the right order to clear the whole board.
As the adventure goes on, knights, keys, doors, ice and teleporters make the boards trickier. Each level you complete earns stars and coins, and new items join your Collection.

Riddles and matches to save the kingdom
In Royaume des Énigmes, the queen needs your help. Every level is a race against time: make matches of symbols on the board and answer riddles to win extra time before the hourglass runs out.
